resources.string: Running. Tap for setup and status.
Setting up this phone as your SIM host
This phone holds your SIM for your phone
This phone can\'t be a host
Its processor type isn\'t supported; HermesSIM needs an ARM phone.
Its bootloader can\'t be unlocked, so it can\'t be rooted.
Look up another spare phone in the HermesSIM app: Host → Check a phone.
Root needs an unlocked bootloader. First turn on Developer options (Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times), then Developer options → OEM unlocking.
Samsung: then turn the phone off, hold Volume Up + Volume Down and plug in USB, and long-press Volume Up to unlock. If OEM unlocking is missing, keep the phone online for a few days and check again.
Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO: link a Mi account in Developer options → Mi Unlock status, then unlock with the Mi Unlock tool on a computer. Xiaomi makes you wait (usually 7 days).
Pixel: in fastboot, run \"fastboot flashing unlock\". Carrier (Verizon) Pixels can\'t be unlocked.
Your maker gives an unlock code on its website (Motorola, Sony); then run the fastboot command it shows.
Then, in fastboot, run \"fastboot flashing unlock\".
Unlocking erases everything on the phone. Afterwards root it with Magisk and install TosbiSim-Host-Magisk.zip in Magisk → Modules.
This phone reports that its bootloader can\'t be unlocked.

Install the Magisk app, patch this phone\'s boot image with it and flash the patched image (Samsung: with Odin). Magisk\'s guide explains each phone type. Then install TosbiSim-Host-Magisk.zip in Magisk → Modules and restart the phone.
Checking root… if Magisk asks, tap Grant.
No root found yet: install Magisk first (see its guide).
%1$s didn\'t answer. Tap Check root again and tap Grant when %1$s asks.
Root was refused. In %1$s → Superuser, allow HermesSIM Host, then check again.

Root works. In the Magisk app, open Modules → Install from storage, choose TosbiSim-Host-Magisk.zip (from tosbisim.com) and restart the phone. HermesSIM starts by itself and this screen continues from there.
%s. Try again; if it keeps failing, send a report below.
The module is installed. Restart the phone: HermesSIM starts by itself and this screen continues from here.
It is turned off in %1$s → %2$s. Turn it on there, then restart the phone.
%1$s is set to remove it at the next restart. To keep HermesSIM, install TosbiSim-Host-Magisk.zip in %1$s → %2$s again, then restart.
It isn\'t installed any more. Install TosbiSim-Host-Magisk.zip in %1$s → %2$s, then restart.
It is installed and waits for a restart.
The phone restarted but HermesSIM didn\'t start as a system app. Reinstall the module; if that doesn\'t help, send a report below.
HermesSIM\'s background service isn\'t running. Restart the phone; if it stays off, reinstall the module.
HermesSIM isn\'t running as a system app (missing %s). Reinstall the module and restart.
Another app is the default SMS app.
The phone may put HermesSIM to sleep.
The phone isn\'t in total silence yet.
Bluetooth is off: your phone reaches this one over Bluetooth.
Fix now puts these back as the module does at start-up.
On your phone (iPhone or Android): install HermesSIM, open it, tap Add host, choose \"%1$s\", then tap Pair when your phone asks.
PIN, pattern or password set: HermesSIM can\'t start after a restart until someone unlocks this phone
None: HermesSIM starts by itself after a restart

With a PIN, pattern or password, Android keeps HermesSIM locked after every restart or power cut until someone unlocks the phone, and nobody will on a phone in your bag or left at home. Set the screen lock to None (or Swipe).
Ready to pair: the first phone that adds this host gets it.
Paired with %1$s. Next, in HermesSIM on your phone: Host → Call audio → Run the call test. Call a friend, and keep this phone next to you to hear whether it makes any sound.
This phone\'s software changed since its call test. Run the call test again in HermesSIM on your phone to turn full voice back on.
Paired with %1$s. This phone runs in Basic mode: texts, call control and the hotspot (call audio isn\'t supported on it yet). Next, in HermesSIM on your phone: turn Box mode on.
Paired with %1$s and full voice is on. Last step, in HermesSIM on your phone: turn Box mode on, so this phone\'s screen stays off.
No SIM found. Insert one (check it is seated well); HermesSIM picks it up by itself.
SIM %d is locked: enter its PIN in HermesSIM on your phone (Host → SIM).
Keep it charged and take it with you (a bag is fine) or leave it at home. To see this screen again, press Volume Up 3 times, then Volume Down 3 times.
%1$s stays paired until another phone connects in the next 5 minutes; that one then replaces it. Continue?
Verified: the HermesSIM team measured call audio on this phone.
Expected to work: its own firmware matches a verified phone\'s audio system. Call audio switches on after a short call test.
Experimental: HermesSIM\'s audio system, not confirmed on this phone yet. Call audio needs the call test.
Basic mode: HermesSIM can\'t relay call audio on this phone yet. Texts, call control and hotspot work.
Not researched yet. Texts, call control and hotspot should work (Basic mode); the call test tells whether call audio works.
Phone, SMS, Bluetooth; default phone and SMS app; never put to sleep; total silence
On; your phone can find this one
This phone can\'t advertise over Bluetooth LE, so your phone can\'t connect to it.
This phone has no Bluetooth LE, so your phone can\'t connect to it.
On; checked again once HermesSIM runs
Another app is using this phone\'s only Bluetooth advertising slot; trying again every minute.
Android refused Bluetooth advertising (code %1$d); trying again.
%s, paired, not in Bluetooth range now
Full voice: the call test passed on this phone
Ready for the call test (run it from HermesSIM on your phone)
Basic mode: no call audio on this phone yet
Charges below %1$d%%, holds at the target, drains above %2$d%%
Off (turn it on from HermesSIM on your phone when setup is done)
The host keeps working. Close and reopen HermesSIM; if this comes back, send a report below so we can fix it.

Phone model, firmware, the names and ranges of its sound chip\'s audio settings (once), how setup and calls go, and when something fails a short log with phone numbers, addresses and names removed. No messages, contacts or IDs. It decides which phones we can call proven.
Couldn\'t send it now; it goes out when the phone is online.
Stop using this phone as a host

Gives the phone back for normal use: its sounds, vibration, screen and buttons, its own phone and messaging apps and Wi-Fi come back, your phone forgets it, and HermesSIM is removed. The phone restarts at the end. %1$s and the unlocked bootloader stay.

Your phone will stop getting this SIM\'s calls and messages. To use the phone as a host again later, install TosbiSim-Host-Magisk.zip in %1$s → %2$s and pair it again.\n\n%1$s (root) and the unlocked bootloader stay: they were set up before HermesSIM. To make the phone fully stock, uninstall %1$s from its own app afterwards.
Removing HermesSIM. The phone restarts in a moment.
Couldn\'t start the removal, so this phone is a host again, as before. Try again; if it keeps failing, open %1$s → %2$s, remove HermesSIM Host and restart the phone.
Installing HermesSIM\'s module from this app: the background service, its permissions and the silence settings. The phone then restarts once.
Another app is the default phone app.
Root refused: %1$s → Superuser → allow HermesSIM Host, then tap Fix now.
SIM %d is blocked: enter its PUK code (on the SIM\'s card, or from your operator) and a new PIN in HermesSIM on your phone (Host → SIM).
This phone is locked to another carrier and refuses SIM %d. That can\'t be unlocked from HermesSIM: ask the carrier the phone came from to unlock it, or use one of its SIMs.
SIM %d is blocked for good (too many wrong PUK codes). Ask your operator for a new SIM.
Switch it on in HermesSIM on your phone (Host → SIM): calls and texts can\'t arrive meanwhile.
Paused until %s (the button gesture); back on when the screen goes off after that
Pairing is open for about %d min.
The server didn\'t take the report. Try again later.
A call is on, so nothing was changed. Try again once it has ended.
Root was refused, so nothing was changed. In %1$s → Superuser, allow HermesSIM Host, then try again.
Couldn\'t prepare the removal, so nothing was changed. Try again; if it keeps failing, send a report below.
Your phone was already told and forgot this host: to keep using it, add it again in HermesSIM on your phone (Add host).

HermesSIM gave this phone back, but the phone didn\'t restart, and the removal ends with that restart. Until then HermesSIM stays out of the way: it doesn\'t silence the phone or touch your calls and messages.\n\nIf HermesSIM is still here after the restart, remove it in %1$s → %2$s and restart again.

HermesSIM gave this phone back, but it is still installed after the restart. It stays out of the way: it doesn\'t silence the phone or touch your calls and messages.\n\nTo finish, remove HermesSIM Host in %1$s → %2$s and restart the phone.
